facts.name: Clayton O. Rooks, III
facts.role: Clerk of Circuit Court and Comptroller
facts.assignment: Jackson County Clerk of Circuit Court and Comptroller; clerk to Board of County Commissioners.

contact.contact_note: Email is the general clerk mailbox, not a personal mailbox or filing authorization. Small-claims fax also serves traffic/misdemeanor. No named assistant published on reviewed contact page.

procedure_checklist.chambers_communications: General inquiries via clerkmail@jacksonclerk.com or main phone. County-commission public record requests directed to county government.
procedure_checklist.filing: Homepage links the e-filing service; no email-filing authorization inferred. Civil service page links small-claims information and publishes fees; detailed collection litigation guidance not abstracted.
procedure_checklist.records: Court records search routes to Civitek county32; official records link routes to MyFloridaCounty county32. Online court record disclaimer and public inspection location/hours retained; no individual docket searched.

facts.review_scope: Four official pages collected; clerk identity, contacts, hours, public records access, records destinations and basic civil service navigation reviewed. Fees and legal-information accordions collected but not substantively audited. No form submissions, case searches or criminal analysis.
facts.summary: Jackson clerk contact, separate street/mailing addresses, small-claims fax and official records destinations verified from official pages.
gaps: No named assistant or direct personal clerk contact established on reviewed pages.
No stated page revision date; fee schedule not certified current.
